purpose: Bound the pre-December-2025 public software family without overclaiming exact producer identity.

lineage.observation: A public predecessor already contained graph-based neuron simplification and 3-D rotation/eigen-axis code long before the December 2025 artifact.

relevant_commits.message: Added functions for Transforming and Scaling neurons

observations: The 2025 legacy repository contains simplify_neuron(), optimal_partition_root(), and explicit coordinate transformation/scaling functions before the Point_data artifact.
The 2025-07-29 fix changes optimal_partition_root() to score the simplified graph and map the selected simplified-root coordinate back to the full neuron with nearest_vertex().

The 2024 transformation history contains the same eig_axis_eulers implementation as the 2023 Neurosetta_old rotations module after formatting/docstring/comment normalization; this is source-level code-family continuity, not artifact provenance.

relevant_commits.observation: Commit text says the implementation updated an old GUI to PySide6 and still lacked subtree/subsetting support.

relevant_commits.message: Manual subtree from point in GUI

lineage.observation: The currently public PySide6 GUI and manual-subtree implementation enter the public NeuRosetta repository only in April 2026, after the December 2025 Point_data artifact.

gui_boundary.publication_claim: The 2026 paper says the NeuRosetta toolbox includes the GUI used for manual verification and dendrite annotation.
gui_boundary.public_history_result: A targeted search of the author's public repositories found no separate public GUI repository that predates the Point_data artifact. The April 2026 NeuRosetta commit references an 'old GUI', but that predecessor is not recovered in the inspected public repository history.
gui_boundary.interpretation: A pre-December private/local GUI remains possible. The public April 2026 GUI cannot be declared the exact December 2025 producer.

conclusion.proven: Relevant software-family functionality existed publicly before Point_data: simplification, subtree selection, root mapping, and coordinate transformation/scaling.
conclusion.unresolved: The exact December 2025 package revision, exact GUI revision, exact manual edits, and exact execution environment that produced Point_data remain unresolved.
conclusion.prohibited_inference: Do not equate the existence of this code family with proof that the December artifact was generated by any particular repository commit.
